title: CreatePrivateEnvironmentRequest
description: Request object for a create private cloud environment request.

environmentName.description: The name of the environment. Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

address.description: The address of the Cloudera Manager managing the Datalake cluster.

user.description: User name for accessing the Cloudera Manager.

authenticationToken.description: A string (text or json) used to authenticate to the Cloudera Manager.

clusterNames.description: The name of the cluster(s) to use as a Datalake for the environment.

environmentQuota.description: Set quota for resources in this Environment.

kubeConfig.description: Name of credentials holding kubeconfig for access to the kubernetes cluster paired with this Environment.

authenticationTokenType.description: How to interpret the authenticationToken field. Defaults to CLEARTEXT_PASSWORD.

namespacePrefix.description: Prefix for all namespaces created by Cloudera Data Platform within this cluster.

domain.description: default domain suffix to work workload applications to use.

platform.description: the K8s cluster type used for the environment.

dockerConfigJson.description: docker pull secrets for the K8s cluster. This is expected to be a docker config json.

storageClass.description: An existing storage class on this kubernetes cluster. If not specified, the default storage class will be used.

EnvironmentQuota.description: Resource pool quota for the Environment.

cpuQuota.description: CPU quota (in Cores) for the Environment. Must be a positive number. By default, a quota won't be set for this resource type in the environment.

memoryQuota.description: Memory quota (in GigaBytes) for the Environment. Must be a positive number. By default, a quota won't be set for this resource type in the environment.

gpuQuota.description: GPU quota (in Cores) for the Environment. Must be a positive number. By default, a quota won't be set for this resource type in the environment.
